scripts.copy-pdfjs: rm -rf public/pdfjs && mkdir -p public/pdfjs && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs public/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.renderer.min.mjs public/pdfjs/pdf.renderer.min.mjs && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts public/pdfjs/standard_fonts && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps public/pdfjs/cmaps && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/wasm public/pdfjs/wasm
scripts.preview: bun run copy-pdfjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: bun run copy-pdfjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
